# @happyprime/env

> 标签: docker, local-development, traefik, wordpress, wp-env

## 简介

Shared local development for WordPress projects: trusted HTTPS, one proxy, one database, one inbox, no per-project setup.

- 官网：https://github.com/happyprime/env
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/happyprime/env.git
